questions.stem: An L-shaped figure is made by removing a $2\text{ cm} \times 3\text{ cm}$ rectangle from the corner of a $6\text{ cm} \times 5\text{ cm}$ rectangle. What is the perimeter of the L-shape?
questions.explanation: Removing a rectangle from a corner adds the two interior edges while removing the corner portion. The outer perimeter $2(6+5) = 22\text{ cm}$, plus the two extra inner edges $2 + 3 - (\text{removed corner edges overlap}) = 2 + 2 = 4\text{ cm}$ extra, giving $22 + 4 = 26\text{ cm}$.
